title: quercus × maroccana
intro: Quercus × maroccana, commonly known as the Marrubium Quercetin, is a hybrid plant derived from the Quercus and Marrubium species. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory agent, which can help to protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and immune system imbalances. The therapeutic actions of Quercus × maroccana include its potential to support cardiovascular health, improve cognitive function, and exhibit antimicrobial and anticancer properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, such as quercetin and kaempferol, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and health benefits.
